body.name: FminDeep
body.type: exact algebraically represented minimal cone face
body.def: \(F_{\min,\mathrm{deep}}\) is the minimal face containing \(\{y:B_{\mathrm{deep}}y=d_{\mathrm{deep}},\ y\in\mathcal K_{\mathrm{deep}}\}\), represented by an exposing chain with entries in \(\mathbb A_{\mathrm{rep}}\).
